answers.core: Only being able to navigate BBCode hyperlinks with a mouse makes them useless for games that want to support controllers and GUI systems that want to be fully navigable by keyboard.
answers.workaround: Adding the link metadata to an array and setting up the controls to cycle through them and send the signal on a button press isn't difficult to do via script, but it shows no visual feedback onscreen. Giving links subfocus would allow different styling appearances if they have subfocus.

title: Grab GUI focus on BBCode hyperlinks in RichTextLabel
